evaluation.feedback: I really enjoyed the infectious energy of this track. The combination of the crisp, high-tempo hip-hop beat and the melodic, heavily processed vocal chops gives it a very modern, professional pop/trap feel. The rhythmic repetition is extremely catchy, and the production quality feels polished and radio-ready.
